subject: Feedback reconciliation: Sam Ortiz (SWE-2) - request for re-eval
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate feedback: Sam Ortiz - mixed scores, need guidance

Hi Logan,

Quick summary from the loop this morning on Sam Ortiz (SWE-2): two interviewers (backend design + system design) gave strong marks (4/5), and the hiring manager panel flagged solid product sense. However, the coding interviewer scored a 2/5 due to missed edge cases and an inefficient approach under time pressure. The aggregated scorecard (attached) lands Sam just below the threshold for hire.

Recruit wants clarity on next steps: do we 1) move forward with a calibration panel to reconcile scores, 2) ask for a short follow-up pair-programming session (30m) to specifically re-evaluate coding, or 3) close the loop with a no-hire? Candidate is actively interviewing elsewhere; Sofia from Acme is asking for an answer by end of week.

Attached: sam_ortiz_scorecard.pdf, candidate_resume_sam_ortiz.pdf

I recommend a quick calibration (option 1) if you feel the low coding score is an outlier. Happy to coordinate times.

Thanks,
Monica
Recruiter | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: sam_ortiz_scorecard.pdf (7 pages, aggregated scores); candidate_resume_sam_ortiz.pdf (1 page).

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback: Sam Ortiz - mixed scores, need guidance

Monica — thanks for the note and the attachments. I reviewed the scorecard. I think the coding score is disproportionate to the rest of the interview data. Sam showed strong system-level thinking in two separate interviews and a clear ability to influence design tradeoffs. Those qualities are rare at SWE-2 and align with our hiring needs for the feature team.

Before closing the candidate, I want to request a short re-eval focused solely on coding: 30 minutes, live pair-programming on a targeted problem (not a full take-home). If Sam performs closer to the other interviewers' signals we should proceed to offer. If Sam repeats the same issues, we can close. Could you schedule a slot tomorrow and include the original coding interviewer and one other calibrated engineer (Laura suggested below)? Please keep the panel small — time is sensitive.

Neha, please advise on whether a re-eval like this requires any special approvals or changes to the interview process. Also confirm whether we can extend the candidate window by 1 week to accommodate.

Logan
Head of Product Engineering | Redwood Inference

On Thu, Jul 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted above]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback: Sam Ortiz - mixed scores, need guidance

Thanks for looping me in. Short answers: yes, we can run a focused re-eval without changing the role or banding; no special HR approval is needed for a one-off follow-up session. We do need to document the reason for the re-eval in the candidate folder (per audit) and limit it to a single session so we don't create unfair process inconsistency.

Please attach the redacted scorecard (we have the aggregated, but include short interviewer notes). Monica — can you drop the interview notes into the Drive link (shared in related_links) and mark which specific coding behaviors we want re-tested? That will help the interviewer focus and ensure fairness.

If the panel decides to proceed after the re-eval, compensation approvals follow the usual band rules. Logan — if you anticipate an exception to comp band, flag it now so we can route approvals early.

-Neha
Dir, People Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback: Sam Ortiz - mixed scores, need guidance

Folks — scheduling update and materials attached. I spoke with Sam this morning; he is available tomorrow (Fri) between 11:00–14:00 PT for a 30-minute pair session. I uploaded the detailed interviewer notes and the original code challenge to the Drive folder and attached a copy here (sam_code_challenge.zip). The original coding interviewer (Victor Chen, external engineer contractor) is available to join, and Laura has agreed to serve as the calibrated internal reviewer.

If we proceed, suggested rubric: focus on problem decomposition, edge-case handling, and clean incremental implementation. Please confirm whether Laura + Victor is acceptable for the panel. If yes, I'll lock a time and share invite with Sam.

Attachments: sam_code_challenge.zip, sam_ortiz_scorecard.pdf

Thanks,
Monica

---
Attachment stubs: sam_code_challenge.zip (sample input files and test harness); sam_ortiz_scorecard.pdf (7 pages).

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback: Sam Ortiz - mixed scores, need guidance

Thanks all — agreed. Laura, Victor, and I will run the 30-minute pair session tomorrow at 11:30 PT. Monica, please send the invite and include the rubric bullet points you outlined.

Neha — please log the re-eval reason in the candidate folder (HIRE-342) and mark the window extension (+7 days). If the calibration panel moves forward to offer, I'll escalate any comp exceptions now rather than later.

One more note: if the re-eval is borderline, instead of a hard no-hire I prefer we consider a probationary hire option (SWE-2 with 6-month performance milestones) — happy to work with People on the exact language if needed. We should document that as one of the possible outcomes before reconvening.

I'll be available by phone if anything changes.

Logan
Head of Product Engineering | Redwood Inference

---
Thread action items: schedule pair session (Monica), upload redacted interviewer notes to Drive (Monica), record re-eval rationale in HIRE-342 (Neha), panel run and decision by 2026-07-10 (Laura/Logan).
